correctness.rationale: Hawthorne proves NIP for the integer power-multiplication expansion for every d>=2 and for the polynomial monomial-multiplication expansion for prime p>=7. On the power sort, restricted multiplication is exactly exponent addition; divisibility by another power therefore defines strict exponent order and gives the order property.
